name: Wildcat Walk-Up Edge
coverage: Man-Free, Press Corners, Walked WILL on Slot

summary.motive: Break the tackle’s pass-protection key by walking between alignments and stances across his face, then attack whichever gap his eyes abandoned last.
summary.keyDefender: ROLB stemming across the tackle’s face — every alignment change forces a reset the rusher never has to make himself
summary.whyItWorks: Pass protection keys off the widest alignment, so a defender who keeps changing it guarantees the blocker eventually guesses wrong once.
summary.failureMode: Chip help from the back or tight end erasing the free inside lane the stem created.

beats.title: 1. The Wildcat Walk Begins
beats.text: The strong edge stands wide at 2.5 yards in a two-point stare, already moving — every alignment change he makes costs the tackle one mental reset.

beats.title: 2. Stem Draws the Tackle Wide
beats.text: A full-speed stem tight over the tackle drags the set outward, then the bounce back wide forces a second reset before the snap count even finishes.

beats.title: 3. Inside Dart Through the Guess
beats.text: On the next reset the walker darts inside instead — attacking the B-gap the tackle’s eyes abandoned while the interior anchors keep the pocket sealed.

beats.title: 4. Flush and Finish
beats.text: The free inside burst flushes the QB directly into the looping contain rusher — the walk created the sack without ever beating a block.

relations.tell: The strong edge keeps switching between a two-point walk and a three-point sprinter stance across the tackle’s face — base fits park him stacked at 4 yards and leave him there.
